programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the most tantalizing bar bites! Josh makes fried halloumi, whitefish tartar, and a salad based on a drink, while Erica prepares beef tartare, escargot, and sliders!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Classic Italian - MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of sardines and caponata on crostini, chicken legs with sausage and peppers, pecorino smashed potatoes, and fennel and orange salad.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Springtime Favorites - MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of grilled asparagus with a 63 degree egg, farro succotash, sous-vide pork tenderloin with blueberry sauce, and a no bake blueberry cheesecake.

programme.title: S02 : E01 SB30_S2E1_2014 - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a Southern-style feast for the whole family including Crunchy Coleslaw and Oven Barbeque Chicken all in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: S02 : E02 SB30_S2E2_2015 - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spring Inspiration - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: S01 : E07 Pan-seared Scallops with Peanut Sauce Noodles and More! - Pardon The Indigestion
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including pan-seared scallops with peanut sauce noodles and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and More! - Pardon The Indigestion
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Start Here - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Start Here by Sohla El-Waylly! Follow along as Shahir makes a punch-you-in-the-face sauce, beautiful seared scallops, an indulgent chocolate pudding pie for grown-ups, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Basilicata - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: S02 : E06 Puglia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Lazio - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Campania - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Emilia Romagna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Calabria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Umbria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Umbria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Basilicata - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: S02 : E06 Puglia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Lazio - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Campania - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Emilia Romagna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Calabria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: S03 : E22 Popular Athens Recipes - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: S03 : E23 Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Canada + Greece - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: S03 : E24 Hearty Greek Fare - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Leaves and Lettuces - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: Madame Butterfly Teatro Alla Scala 2016
programme.desc: In Madama Butterfly (Teatro alla Scala, 2016), a young Japanese woman enters into a marriage with an American naval officer, filled with hope for a new life. As time passes, the contrast between her expectations and reality becomes more profound. The opera unfolds with deep emotional intensity, leading to a powerful and poignant conclusion.

programme.title: Whats On - 12 - Special and Unique Festivals
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 12 - Special and Unique Festivals
programme.desc: From Malta to Morocco, unique festivals capture Mediterranean creativity. Malta hosts the Valletta Green Festival, Notte Bianca, Malta Air Show, and Gharb International Kite and Wind Festival. Portugal celebrates with Festa das Cruzes, Morocco Dream City Festival dazzles with arts and music, Croatia brings the avant garde MoDem Festival, and Italy hosts the historic Venice Debutante Grand Ball. These festivals showcase the extraordinary, the festive, and the unforgettable.

programme.title: S01:E01 Gold Cuisine EP 1 - Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: Welcome to Gold Cuisine on Med TV. Today Chef Chryso Lefou creates vibrant chicken fajitas, blending tender chicken, colorful peppers, and fresh lime for a Mediterranean take on a Mexican favorite. Later, special guest Galateia Pamboridi presents traditional halloumi pies (Χαλλουμωτές), a classic Cypriot treat with a golden crust and rich, cheesy filling. A perfect mix of flavors and tradition.

programme.title: S01:E06 Dalmatian Brunch Ep 6 - Brač (Supetar)
programme.desc: On Brač, famed for its white stone, Zlatni Rat beach, and Vidova Gora, we stopped in Supetar to taste tradition. Restaurateur Teo Dragičević served us šporka juha, mišanca, and vitalac—authentic island flavors rooted in Brač’s rich culinary heritage.

programme.title: Med Destinations Ios

programme.title: Malini Angelica Andalucia
programme.desc: Join Angelica Malini on an unforgettable journey through Andalucía, southern Spain’s most colorful and captivating region, as they explore Cordoba and Cadiz. Famous for flamenco, tapas, and stunning Moorish architecture, Andalucía’s rich history comes alive here. In Cordoba, the host marvels at the breathtaking Mezquita, a grand mosque turned cathedral. In Cadiz, an ancient Phoenician city, they soak in sweeping Atlantic views and a corniche with hints of North Africa. This episode immerses viewers in the culture, history, and vibrant spirit of one of Spain’s most enchanting regions.

A myth that highlights the harmony between wisdom and strength.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 2, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un vigorizante tratamiento de spa, una lección de cocina, una sesión de snorkel: Kim tiene experiencias en las Maldivas que la dejan completamente rejuvenecida.

programme.title: S01 : E51 Mochila Bakú, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici se maravilla ante las maravillas arquitectónicas de Bakú, la capital de Azerbaiyán, mientras compra recuerdos en el bazar local.

programme.title: S01 : E11 La Búsqueda Nagaland, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras aprende a preparar un manjar de cerdo Naga, Alex comprende los diferentes platos y estilos de cocina de las tribus de Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Xplora República Checa Praga - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Con un incomparable encanto del viejo mundo, Praga es la respuesta de la República Checa a París. Es considerada una de las ciudades más bellas del mundo. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre la historia y la arquitectura de esta fascinante ciudad en lugares como el majestuoso castillo de Praga, la plaza Wenceslao y un cementerio judío. Pero la mejor experiencia que tiene en Praga es cuando interactúa con el Palacio del Príncipe de Lobkowicz.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Herencia Mundial Chipre - World Heritage
programme.desc: Orte, die als Erbstücke gelten und die wir als nächstes weitergeben werden. Von der UNESCO als Weltkulturerbe gestempelt.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Mochila Ganja, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Azerbaiyán tiene muchas maravillas naturales que podrían sorprender a un viajero. Desde volcanes de lodo físicos hasta impresionantes formaciones rocosas, Sabrina Chakici es testigo de algunos de ellos en el Parque Nacional de Gobustán. Después de esto, llega a la ciudad de Ganja, donde descubre la historia en lugares espectaculares como el Parque Heyder Aliyev, el Mausoleo Imamzadeh, la Mezquita Juma y el Mausoleo Nizami.

programme.title: S01 : E12 La Búsqueda Nagaland & Shillong, India - Quest
programme.desc: Desde la tradicional carne de cerdo ahumada en Nagaland hasta la carne de rana en Shillong, Alex descubre los secretos de la cocina tribal en Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora República Checa Karlovy Vary - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Cuenta la leyenda que Karlovy Vary fue fundada por el rey checo y emperador romano Carlos IV, quien una tarde descubrió aquí un manantial único mientras cazaba ciervos. Esta histórica ciudad balneario de la República Checa es conocida por el poder curativo de sus aguas termales. Rohan explora algunos de ellos, incluidos Freedom y Rusalka Springs, y comprende su importancia para la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E10 La Búsqueda Jorhat, India - Quest
programme.desc: Desde pollo con brotes de bambú hasta un plato de tallo de plátano llamado Posola Musar Ali Khan, Alex aprende a preparar algunos platos populares de Assam.

programme.desc: Desde descansar en hamacas en la playa hasta tomar bebidas en un yate privado, Kim se da cuenta de que Maldivas es el destino perfecto para relajarse con estilo.

programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.desc: Desde nadar con tortugas centenarias hasta visitar una fábrica de cocos, Alex tiene muchas experiencias poco convencionales en las islas de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Austria Viena 2 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha descubre el lado contemporáneo de Viena en algunos de sus barrios más modernos y animados.

programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici visita Manchester, la ciudad del fútbol y la moda, la ciudad del patrimonio y el hedonismo, la ciudad de la revolución industrial.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Naila 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Khargosh es un plato olvidable ya que hay varios pasos para prepararlo y además lleva mucho tiempo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Irlanda Dublin - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: Los pubs en Irlanda son mucho más que un lugar para beber; son una institución. Son puntos de acceso social, centros de encuentros culturales y diversión irlandesa. Olivia visita el pub más antiguo del país en Dublín, la capital, donde puede comprobar el amor que tienen los irlandeses por contar historias. Más tarde, va a la Guinness Storehouse para descubrir la historia detrás de la poción oscura, que no sólo es la cerveza más común en Irlanda, sino también una especie de símbolo nacional.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: En un viaje a Innsbruck, Eliseo descubre historias de un emperador del siglo XV, bajo cuyo reinado la ciudad alcanzó su apogeo.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Six Senses, Tailandia - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Rodeado de aguas turquesas, playas vírgenes y exuberante vegetación tropical, Koh Samui ofrece a Elisha la combinación perfecta de serenidad y lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Irlanda Galway - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: Connemara, famosa por sus paisajes escarpados y lagos relucientes, es una de las regiones más románticas de Irlanda. En un viaje a este desierto rocoso, Olivia visita algunos de sus castillos perfectos para postales. En el idílico castillo de Ballynahinch, podrá experimentar la combinación perfecta de historia, lujo y belleza rural. También se siente profundamente conmovida por la historia de amor que dio origen a Kylemore Abbey, un fascinante castillo que parece la última página de un libro de cuento de hadas.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Guía XP Muscat - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Muscat, que se extiende a lo largo de casi 25 kilómetros a lo largo de la costa de Omán, combina el glamour del nuevo mundo y el encanto del viejo mundo para brindar a los visitantes una muestra de la verdadera Arabia.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Herencia Mundial Delhi - World Heritage
programme.desc: Hojee las páginas de la historia mientras se propone explorar y comprender la arquitectura de los monumentos islámicos construidos a partir del siglo XI en Delhi.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Irlanda Wild Atlantic Way - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: La costa oeste de Irlanda, alguna vez considerada el fin del mundo conocido, es la parte más mágica de esta isla histórica. Olivia se embarca en un viaje a lo largo de la pintoresca ruta costera llamada Wild Atlantic Way, para explorar la belleza salvaje de esta costa escarpada con sus espectaculares acantilados, playas azotadas por el viento y aldeas bucólicas. En el camino se detiene en Burren, un paisaje lunar pedregoso de karst, donde ve los escarpados acantilados de Moher al borde del Atlántico en constante agitación.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Guía XP Wayanad, India - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Wayanad, un pueblo bucólico de Kerala, ofrece un itinerario lleno de vida silvestre, ayurveda, plantaciones y spas.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spas del Mundo Kamalaya, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en una hermosa ladera en Koh Samui, Tailandia, Kamalaya es un santuario de bienestar aislado con playa privada. Aquí, Jamie Srubis prueba una variedad de tratamientos de spa, como el tratamiento de envoltura y exfoliación corporal desintoxicante Swaadhika, que incluye una sesión de sauna de infrarrojos lejanos y un masaje de drenaje linfático. También prueba el yoga y el aeróbic acuático y luego disfruta de una comida desintoxicante.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Xplora Irlanda Belfast - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: En abril de 1912, el RMS Titanic zarpó en su viaje inaugural a la ciudad de Nueva York y trágicamente se hundió en el Océano Atlántico Norte después de chocar contra un iceberg. Más de 100 años después, el orgulloso pueblo de Belfast continúa honrando la memoria de su “Reina del Océano” a través de su fantástica exposición, el Titanic Belfast. Olivia visita este espectáculo multimedia imperdible que hace que la historia del transatlántico más famoso del mundo cobre vida para ella.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Guía XP Seychelles - Xp Guide
programme.desc: En una aventura de isla en isla en las Seychelles, Freishia descubre que cada isla tiene algo único que ofrecer.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Relajación Earl's Regency, Sri Lanka - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Guía XP Seychelles - Xp Guide
programme.desc: En una aventura de isla en isla en las Seychelles, Freishia descubre que cada isla tiene algo único que ofrecer.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Xplora Irlanda Belfast - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: En abril de 1912, el RMS Titanic zarpó en su viaje inaugural a la ciudad de Nueva York y trágicamente se hundió en el Océano Atlántico Norte después de chocar contra un iceberg. Más de 100 años después, el orgulloso pueblo de Belfast continúa honrando la memoria de su “Reina del Océano” a través de su fantástica exposición, el Titanic Belfast. Olivia visita este espectáculo multimedia imperdible que hace que la historia del transatlántico más famoso del mundo cobre vida para ella.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Espacios en la Ciudad Budapest, Hungría - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde la iglesia de San Matías hasta el Palacio Real, Catriona explora las atracciones icónicas de Budapest, "el París del Este".

programme.title: S01 : E15 La Búsqueda Kolkata 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Muchas colonias europeas compitieron por el dominio y la supremacía cultural en Bengala. Como resultado, su cocina absorbió muchas influencias occidentales.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Xplora Austria Viena 1 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Desde una ópera hasta palacios barrocos, las magníficas reliquias del pasado imperial de Viena tienen muchas historias que contar.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera del Mapa Kavaratti, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: A través de aventuras como el paravelismo en Kavaratti y el buceo en Bangaram, Alex descubre la belleza de las islas de coral de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Austria Salzburgo - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Fuera del Mapa Minicoy, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Irlanda Dublin - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: Los pubs en Irlanda son mucho más que un lugar para beber; son una institución. Son puntos de acceso social, centros de encuentros culturales y diversión irlandesa. Olivia visita el pub más antiguo del país en Dublín, la capital, donde puede comprobar el amor que tienen los irlandeses por contar historias. Más tarde, va a la Guinness Storehouse para descubrir la historia detrás de la poción oscura, que no sólo es la cerveza más común en Irlanda, sino también una especie de símbolo nacional.
